استمعنا (form VIII)
# اِسْتَمَعْنَا (istamaʕnā) /is.ta.maʕ.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
# اُسْتُمِعْنَا (ustumiʕnā) /us.tu.miʕ.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
